name: Build & Deploy workflow
on:
  workflow_dispatch: # Menambahkan tombol trigger manual di GitHub UI
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  generate-matrix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.set-matrix.outputs.matrix }}
    steps:
      - name: Ambil list branches dari API dan generate matrix
        id: set-matrix
        run: |
          echo "Fetching branches…"
          jq --version
          json=$(curl -sS --max-time 10 https://emr.clenicapp.com/api/get-branches) || true
          if [ -z "${json}" ] || ! echo "${json}" | jq -e . >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Warning: failed to fetch or parse branches API response; using empty matrix."
            matrix='[]'
          else
            matrix=$(echo "${json}" | jq -c '.data' 2>/dev/null) || matrix='[]'
          fi
          echo "Matrix: $matrix"
          echo "matrix=$matrix" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "26"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Cache Angular
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: .angular/cache
          key: angular-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            angular-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci --legacy-peer-deps --no-audit --no-fund

      - name: Build app
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --openssl-legacy-provider
        run: npm run build -- --configuration production

      - name: Upload build artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: app-build
          path: ./dist/puskesmas-app/
          retention-days: 1

  deploy:
    needs: [build, generate-matrix]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      max-parallel: 20
      matrix:
        folder: ${{ fromJson(needs.generate-matrix.outputs.matrix) }}

    steps:
      - name: Download build artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: app-build
          path: ./dist/puskesmas-app/

      - name: Setup SSH Key
        env:
          SSH_KEY: ${{ secrets.SSH_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          SSH_HOST: ${{ secrets.SSH_HOST }}
          SSH_PORT: ${{ secrets.SSH_PORT || '22' }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p ~/.ssh/
          echo "$SSH_KEY" > ~/.ssh/id_rsa
          chmod 600 ~/.ssh/id_rsa
          ssh-keyscan -p "$SSH_PORT" -H "$SSH_HOST" >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts

      - name: Deploy to ${{ matrix.folder }} via Rsync
        env:
          SSH_HOST: ${{ secrets.SSH_HOST }}
          SSH_USER: ${{ secrets.SSH_USER }}
          SSH_PORT: "22"
          TARGET_DIR: "/home/clenicapp.com/apps/${{ matrix.folder }}.clenicapp.com/v1/"
        run: |
          rsync -avz --no-times \
            --rsync-path="mkdir -p $TARGET_DIR && rsync" \
            -e "ssh -p $SSH_PORT -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa \
                -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new \
                -o ConnectTimeout=120 \
                -o ConnectionAttempts=5 \
                -o ServerAliveInterval=15 \
                -o ServerAliveCountMax=6" \
            ./dist/puskesmas-app/ \
            "$SSH_USER@$SSH_HOST:$TARGET_DIR"
